title: Renewable Energy India Expo (REI) 2026
venue: India Expo Mart, Knowledge Park II
summary: Meet Sor Connect leadership at Asia's premier clean energy expo. We will showcase our 200+ MW utility & industrial EPC engineering portfolio, PM-KUSUM feeder solutions, and automated SCADA systems.
description:
Renewable Energy India Expo (REI 2026) is India's largest international green energy gathering, bringing together leading developers, Tier-1 module manufacturers, DISCOM regulators, and EPC EPC leaders.

Visit Sor Connect at Booth B-114 (Hall 3) to discuss:
• Multi-megawatt industrial rooftop solar feasibility & DISCOM net-metering
• PM-KUSUM Component A & C solar feeder engineering for EPC contractors
• 25-Year IoT telemetry & predictive string inverter maintenance
• Direct Tier-1 component alliances with Reliance New Energy, Hitachi, and Sungrow

title: SolarQuarter State Leadership Awards & Clean Energy Summit
summary: Sor Connect was honored with the prestigious 'Solar EPC Company of the Year' award, recognized for delivering over 150+ MW of turnkey industrial and rural clean energy infrastructure.
description:
The SolarQuarter State Leadership Awards Rajasthan 2025 convened leading energy commissioners, state DISCOM authorities, and renewable EPC contractors.

Sor Connect's Managing Director Vivek Jain accepted the Solar EPC Company of the Year award on stage, celebrating our engineering benchmarks in RCC structural wind loading up to 160 km/h, zero-accident civil commissioning, and rapid DISCOM net-metering delivery across North India.

title: Intersolar India 2026 — Powering Next-Gen C&I Decarbonization
summary: Sor Connect technical leadership presents technical case studies on high-ambient bifacial solar yields, industrial captive Open Access, and 25-year predictive asset management.
description:
Intersolar India / The smarter E India is the pioneering exhibition and conference for India's solar industry.

Our engineering delegates will present live demonstrations and technical talks:
• Optimizing Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) below ₹2.90/unit for continuous manufacturing plants
• Microclimate thermal simulation and shadow clipping analysis in PVsyst
• Turnkey engineering compliance for CEIG and DISCOM grid synchronizations

title: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Awareness Seminar & Net-Metering Clinic
venue: Sor Connect Engineering Headquarters, Vaishali Nagar
summary: Comprehensive public workshop for homeowners and residential welfare associations (RWAs) demonstrating subsidy application procedures up to ₹78,000 under PM Surya Ghar.
description:
Over 250+ homeowners, RWA presidents, and institutional representatives attended our interactive PM Surya Ghar workshop.

Highlights of the session:
• Direct walk-through of the national portal application and DISCOM meter installation steps
• Live demonstration of Tier-1 DCR bifacial panels and hybrid inverters on our test facility roof
• Instant calculation of monthly savings, 3.2-year payback periods, and 25-year warranty protection
organizer: Sor Connect Consumer Clean Energy Initiative

title: EPS Energy Excellence Gala: Best Commercial Rooftop Solar Project
summary: Sor Connect was recognized with the EPS Energy Award for engineering the flagship 250 kWp solar installation atop DoubleTree by Hilton Agra, setting new standards in hospitality solar adoption.
description:
The annual EPS Energy Awards celebrate milestone engineering achievements across Uttar Pradesh and North India.

Sor Connect's Agra engineering division was recognized for executing the zero-downtime rooftop installation for DoubleTree by Hilton Agra. The plant mitigates over 260 metric tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and cuts property grid consumption by 35%.

title: Foundation Milestone: 10 MW Captive Solar Park for Marble & Stone Consortium
summary: Groundbreaking ceremony for a 10 MW captive solar facility dedicated to Kishangarh marble gangsaw units, ensuring zero-carbon manufacturing and long-term energy price stability.
description:
Industry leaders from the Kishangarh Stone Association gathered for the foundation stone ceremony of the 10 MW captive solar park.

Key Engineering Parameters:
• 18,500+ high-efficiency mono-PERC bifacial solar modules
• 33kV dedicated transmission line connecting to nearest grid substation
• Projected annual generation exceeding 16.8 million clean kilowatt-hours (units)
• Estimated corporate electricity bill reduction of over 42% for participating industrial units
